preconditions.description: Attacker must have at least some TOFU tokens to initiate transfer
Contract must have totalSupply > 5000000000e9 (5 billion tokens with 9 decimals) for the buggy burn logic to activate

exploit_hint: Call the transfer() function with any amount when totalSupply > 5 billion tokens. The bug is in the _transfer() function where it subtracts newAmount from sender's balance, then subtracts burnFee again from the same sender's balance, effectively deducting (newAmount + burnFee) instead of just (amount). This causes the sender's balance to be reduced more than intended while totalSupply only decreases by burnFee, creating inconsistency between total token balances and totalSupply.
